name: Penuel
title: Descendant of Hur from the tribe of Judah
summary: Penuel is a biblical figure mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the son of Hur and father of Gedor. He belonged to the tribe of Judah and was part of the lineage of Caleb. He should not be confused with the place Penuel (Peniel), which is associated with Jacob's struggle with God.

keyEvents.title: Penuel mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Penuel is listed as the son of Hur and father of Gedor in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Hur
keyEvents.description: Hur was the firstborn son of Ephrath and father of several sons, including Penuel. Hur's lineage was significant within the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Founding of Gedor
keyEvents.description: Penuel is described as the father of Gedor, which likely means he was the founder or leader of the city of Gedor.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's lineage
keyEvents.description: Penuel belonged to the broader lineage of Caleb through Hur and Ephrathah, a prominent family in the tribe of Judah that played an important role in Israel's history.
